news.analysis: It was a rough afternoon for Mitchell, who left the game briefly with a back injury before returning. He then injured his knee and did not come back into the game. news.contents: Los Angeles Chargers running back Keaton Mitchell is questionable to return to Sunday's Week 11 game against the New York Jets with a knee injury, the team announced. Mitchell first left with a back injury in the opening quarter and came back with 13:34 left in the second, returning a kickoff 27 yards. Warren has managed only 11 total receptions over the last four games and has not scored since Week 2. The Colts' passing game is a mess right now, and Warren's fantasy value has greatly suffered as a result.
